    top_edge = [q[0][1], q[0][2]]
    bottom_edge = [q[-1][1], q[-1][2]]
    left_edge = [q[1][0], q[2][0]]
    right_edge = [q[1][-1], q[2][-1]]
    
    # Check symmetries
    def horiz_sym(lst): return lst[0] == lst[1]
    def vert_sym(lst): return lst[0] == lst[1]
    
    features = {
        'center': tuple(center),
        'corners': tuple(corners),
        'top_edge': tuple(top_edge),
        'bottom_edge': tuple(bottom_edge),

    # Horizontal symmetry (left col vs rev right col)

from collections import Counter

def analyze_quadrant(data, qr, qc):
    start_r, end_r = qr*4, (qr+1)*4
    start_c, end_c = qc*4, (qc+1)*4
    
    qs = [data[r][start_c:end_c] for r in range(start_r, end_r)]
    
    # All values
    all_vals = [qs[rr][cc] for rr in range(4) for cc in range(4)]
    cf = Counter(all_vals)
    n_unique = len(cf)
    mode_val = max(cf.keys(), key=lambda k: cf[k])

outs = []
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(4):
        qrs.append(i)
        qcs.append(j)
        outs.append(outputs_4x4[i][j])

print("Testing various position formulas:")

    ('qr + qc', lambda: [((r+c) % 4) for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),

    ('(qr+qc)%6', lambda: [(r+c) % 6 for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('(qr*qc)%7', lambda: [(r*c) % 7 for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('max(qr,qc)+1', lambda: [max(r,c)+1 for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('abs(qr-qc)', lambda: [abs(r-c) for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('qr*2 + qc', lambda: [r*2+c for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('(qr+1)*qc', lambda: [(r+1)*c for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('(qr+1)*(qc+1)', lambda: [(r+1)*(c+1) for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
    ('abs((qr+1)-(qc+1))', lambda: [abs(r-c+1) for r,c in zip(qrs, qcs)]),
]

for name, fn in test_formulas:
    result = sorted(set(fn()))
    unique_outs = sorted(set(outs))
    print(f"{name}: values={result}, target={unique_outs}, match={sorted(result) == sorted(unique_outs)}")

# More targeted: map each specific position to its output
